kinds.label: 3D-print head (clone of an existing one)
kinds.help: A new nozzle size or head that reuses an existing print tool's extruder and heater.

kinds.label: Paste or glue dispenser
kinds.help: A pump or plunger driven by a PWM output.
checklist: Cartridge loaded and the nozzle is clear
Work surface is clean and clamped

kinds.label: Hot wire foam cutter
kinds.help: Heated wire for cutting foam. Power is capped and a timer switches it off.
checklist: Wire installed, taut and clear of the stock
Foam is clamped flat and cannot shift
Fire extinguisher or water nearby and you stay present

kinds.label: Needle / vibrating knife
kinds.help: Oscillating needle or knife driven by a PWM output.
checklist: Needle or blade is firmly seated
Hands and cables clear of the cutting path

kinds.label: Other powered cutter
kinds.help: Any other cutting tool driven by a PWM power output.
checklist: Tool is securely mounted and its cable is clear of the gantry
Work is clamped and the area is clear

kinds.label: Unpowered blade or knife
kinds.help: Cuts by moving through the material: a drag or tangential blade with no power.
checklist: Work is clamped and the area is clear

kinds.label: Passive tool (pen, probe, holder)
kinds.help: No power output: a pen, probe, camera or holder. Only needs its offsets and feed rate.
checklist: Work is clamped and the area is clear

categories.label: Additive
categories.help: Adds material: print heads, paste or glue dispensers.

categories.label: Subtractive
categories.help: Removes or cuts material: lasers, spindles, hot wires, knives.

categories.label: Passive
categories.help: Does not make or cut anything: pens, probes, cameras, holders.
